Long glass: extreme range and damage, very slow fire; its purple-cored rounds pierce a line of enemies. Requires power. In first person press Q at the stand to take its rifle (Right Mouse scope).

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Offense |
| Main crystal | Purple |
| Build cost | 300 Purple |
| Upgrades give | +HP, +Damage, +Range, +Stored Power |
